checklist.question: Do the candidate claims, six-group identity, Scheme B role, support conditions, and falsification conditions match the frozen research charter?
Does the capability matrix cover the intended mechanisms and layers without reusing historical confirmation cases or creating proxy claims?
checklist.comment: Approved on review round 2 after BC-CAUSAL-03 was corrected to planning.causal_response and the matrix-to-gate failure-class closure audit was added.

checklist.question: Does the template contract separate causal variables, invariants, nuisance variables, oracle, veto, and task-local state without gold leakage?
Is the human rubric sufficient for allowed multiple plans, semantic source trade-offs, recovery history, disagreement, and unscorable items?
Do the partition, seed, stopping, exclusion, replacement, confirmation-unseal, and E2E selection rules prevent result-driven case selection?
Does the design keep planning, execution, quality, and external-validity claims separate and retain negative or incomplete results?
checklist.comment: Approved on review round 2 after the audit was strengthened to reject any primary_failure_class absent from its primary gate.

overall_comment: The only substantive round-1 defect was corrected without new inconsistency or side effect. BC-CAUSAL-03 now uses the defined and previously unused planning.causal_response class, manifest hashes were synchronized, and all six protocol items satisfy the approval conditions.

review_rounds.finding: BC-CAUSAL-03 used planning.failure_state, which was absent from G4.failure_classes; the audit did not validate cell failure-class membership in its primary gate.
The taxonomy mismatch and missing closure audit were corrected; no new inconsistency or side effect was found.

instructions: Human decisions are recorded verbatim in outcome and preserved by review round. Automatic audit may validate this file but must not author or infer approval.
